verdicts.reason: A actually reflows for the banner: the quote reads left to right on the red panel at a legible size and the skyline sits as a side image. Its flaws: the author name is tiny and stranded mid-panel, the decorative rules float loose beside it, the skyline is cropped into a small, weak tile, and the white frame is lost. B just shrinks the original into a small centred square, so the quote and author are unreadably tiny and the left and right thirds of the canvas are empty grey.
